newsitem.title: USA: US cash crude grades end March firm, volumes thin.
newsitem.headline: US cash crude grades end March firm, volumes thin.

text.p: U.S. cash crudes staged a last day rally for March Louisiana sweet barrels, leaving the April grades to wallow at mostly steady price differentials.

Traders said the last day for March pipeline scheduling resulted in a spate of deals for Light Louisiana Sweet/St. James, where interest propped LLS to trade from flat to 20 cents higher in comparison to the market late on Monday.
Other grades did not attract the same attention, noticeably for sour barrels where quiet business kept differentials weak on bearish supply-demand fundamentals.
Spot crude gained on Nigerian oil worker strike threats.
